name: Disorder of Carbohydrate Metabolism

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Disorders of Carbohydrate Metabolism

criteria.description: Presence of hypoglycemia, hepatomegaly, or failure to thrive in infancy or early childhood
Abnormal carbohydrate metabolites detected in blood or urine (e.g., elevated galactose, fructose, or glycogen intermediates)
Deficient activity of specific carbohydrate metabolism enzymes confirmed by enzymatic assay
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes related to carbohydrate metabolism
Hepatomegaly or liver steatosis on abdominal ultrasound or MRI

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical presentation plus biochemical abnormalities and enzyme assay confirming deficient enzyme activity
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory.

searchTerms: low blood sugar not fixed by fasting
hypoglycemia that doesn't improve when not eating

pathognomonic.symptomName: Hepatomegaly with abnormal liver function tests
searchTerms: big liver and liver function problems
failure to gain weight as baby

common.notes: Metabolic acidosis secondary to impaired carbohydrate metabolism

common.symptomName: Muscle weakness due to glycogen storage abnormalities
searchTerms: weak muscles due to sugar storage problems
muscle fatigue related to glycogen storage
seizures caused by low blood sugar

laboratory: Elevated carbohydrate metabolites in blood and urine
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes encoding carbohydrate metabolism enzymes (e.g., GALT, G6PC, ALDOB)
other: Enzyme activity assays showing deficient carbohydrate metabolism enzymes

distinguishingFeatures: Predominant glycogen accumulation in liver and muscle
Specific enzyme deficiencies different from carbohydrate metabolism enzymes
Multisystem involvement with prominent neurological symptoms
Lactic acidosis without primary carbohydrate metabolism enzyme deficiency

redFlags: Severe hypoglycemia leading to seizures or coma
Rapidly progressive hepatomegaly with liver failure
references: Orphanet: Disorders of Carbohydrate Metabolism - ORPHA:79161
UpToDate: Inborn Errors of Carbohydrate Metabolism
